Commentary.Commentary: We are back for Australia's second innings. The umpires are out in the middle as the West Indies players are seen in a huddle around the sidelines before walking out to the middle. Usman Khawaja and David Warner are the openers for Australia. Kemar Roach has the new ball in hand and is raring to go.

Brendon Julian and Michael Hussey are pitchside and they inform us that Australia have gone for the heavy roller. They add that the pitch will stay good for at least the first hour and 14 overs or 50 minutes of play is left in the day, whichever comes last.
... THIRD INNINGS ...

West Indies fought hard but after Jermaine Blackwood departed it all went downhill quite quickly. Brooks though played well and Chase also showed some good fight but against a disciplined bowling attack they could not hang on for a long time. Earlier, Kraigg Brathwaite and debutant Tagenarine Chanderpaul had set up a good foundation for the rest of the batting line-up but it was always a case of finding one or two quick wickets for the Aussies and then with pitch fastening up, West Indies could not handle the classe of the Aussies. Australia would be looking to get some quick runs with the bat now and get that lead over 450 at least. Let's see how they go about their business now. Stay tuned.

West Indies are bowled out for 283 and Australia have a lead of 315. They have not enforced the follow-on though but would be pretty happy with their bowling effort in the second and final session on Day 3. As expected, the second new ball did the trick for them as Starc got rid of Blackwood who was showing some great grit and determination and that opened the floodgates as the lower middle order and tail-enders found it tough against some quality bowling. Cummins ended with three wickets along with Starc who also took three and overall they got six wickets with the second new ball by giving away just 39 runs.

OUT! CAUGHT! That's it, West Indies have been bowled out here! Pat Cummins bangs this one in short over middle and at a good height as well. Alzarri Joseph looks to take it on but mistimes it badly. The ball pops up around the mid-wicket region and David Warner over there takes a simple catch and sprints back to the dressing room which is an indication that Australia will bat again. West Indies are bundled out for 283 and Australia have a mammoth first-innings lead of 315 runs.
Commentary.Howout: c David Warner b Pat Cummins

Commentary.Commentary: Good-length delivery around middle. This one nips in a touch and Joseph nudges it onto the leg side.
Nicely flighted around the off pole, Seales leaves it alone.
Tossed up around middle and leg, Jayden Seales blocks it off the front foot.
Jayden Seales is the last man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! A brilliant reflex catch at first slip by Steven Smith and Kemar Roach has to walk back for a duck. Lovely flight on this one from Nathan Lyon and he pushes this outside the off stump as well. Roach goes for the expansive drive against the turn and ends up getting a thick outside edge. Smith has almost no time react but does well to push back and grab it with both hands to his left. Australia are now just one wicket away from bundling out West Indies.
Commentary.Howout: c Steven Smith b Nathan Lyon

Commentary.Commentary: Flighted, around off stump, Kemar Roach blocks it out.
Tossed up around off stump, Roach pushes it out on the off side.
Sharp turn there. This is tossed up on middle and the ball spins into the right-hander. Joseph gets an inside edge on it that goes just past the diving man at short leg. they do get a single.
Kemar Roach is the next man in.

OUT! LBW! The skipper with yet another masterful stroke and West Indies lose their eight wicket. Pat Cummins serves this one a touch fuller on off stump and angles it in. The ball nips back in sharply off the deck and keeps a shade low as well. Roston Chase gets completely caught on the crease and ends up getting pinged right in front. There is a huge appeal and the finger is raised almost instanteanously. No review from Chase and rightly so as ball Tracking shows it was crashing into middle stump. West Indies still need 117 runs to avoid the follow on.
Cummins keeps it full and tries to attack the pads but spills it down the leg side. Chase misses the flick as well.
On a good length, close to the off stump and holding its line. Roston Chase makes an assured leave.
This is full and on off, Chase drives it straight towards mid off.
Around the top of off and just nipping back in a touch. Chase covers the line well and makes the block.
Starts off with a pitched-up delivery around the off stump. Roston Chase gets on the front foot and defends it out.
Pat Cummins (19-6-34-1) is back into the attack.
On a length and around the pads, Joseph defends it out. Maiden!
This is tossed up around leg stump and turning further down the leg side, Alzarri Joseph leaves it alone.
Similar delivery to the previous one, full and turning into the pads, Joseph nudges down behind short leg.
Nicely tossed up on leg stump and turning in, Joseph prods forward to defend.
Gives it a bit more flight and bowls it around the pads, Alzarri Joseph plays it with soft hands and towards short leg.
A tad bit quicker and around middle, Joseph blocks it out.

Drinks break! A very productive hour of play for the Aussies. The second new ball has done the trick for them as Starc was too hot to handle with that shape into the batter. West Indies are still 316 runs behind but Chase is still there and Joseph too has shown in the past that he can bat at this level. A tough final hour of play awaits them and let's see how things pan out.
FOUR! A real gift and Roston Chase duly obliges. This is full and angling down the leg side, Chase just tickles it fine and finds the fine leg fence.
Full and straight, Chase punches it straight back at the bowler.
Good length around off, this is defended out on the off side.
Pitches it up now and bowls it outside off, Chase lets it through to the keeper.
A length ball around middle, Chase blocks it out.
On a fullish length and on the pads, Roston Chase clips it away in front of mid-wicket and comfortably gets back for the second.
Flighted, around off and Alzarri Joseph leaves it alone.
Tosses it up on the stumps, Joseph defends it out.

FOUR LEG BYES! Through everyone! Lovely overspin on that delivery from Lyon as he lands it on a nagging length and around off stump. The ball turns in sharply and goes through the defense of Joseph. the ball clips the flap of the pad and beats Alex Carey behind the stumps before running away into the fence.
A tad shorter and turning into middle, Alzarri Joseph manages to keep it out.
This is floated up full and on leg stump, Chase drives it down to long on for a single.
Turning it in off a good length and into the pads. Chase plays it off the back foot and towards mid-wicket.
Good length again from Green, over off stump and Joseph stays solid in defense.
On a good length around off and nipping away a touch, Joseph watchfully leaves it alone.
Very full and around off, Joseph forces the drive through covers and picks up a couple of runs.
A bumper over middle stump with not much pace on it. Joseph ducks under it well.
Good length over middle and leg, kept out on the leg side.
NO BALL! Full and well outside the off stump, Alzarri Joseph leaves it alone for the keeper to collect. Green oversteps and a no ball is called.
Fullish length angling on the pads, Roston Chase flicks it away through square leg and picks up a single.
On a good length and turning in from around middle, Joseph tries to defend but misses and gets hit high on the pads.
Tosses it up a bit wide of the off stump and Alzarri Joseph just lets it through to the keeper.
Flighted delivery around the off stump, this is pushed out towards cover.
Nicely tossed up on off stump, Joseph defends it out.
Looped up on the pads and turning down the leg side, Joseph leaves it alone.
Tosses it up on a length and turning in from middle and leg, Joseph blocks it off the inside edge towards short leg.
Nathan Lyon (18-1-59-1) is back into the attack.
Keeps it full but this is sprayed down the leg side. Left alone by Chase.
Pitched up around the off stump, Chase blocks it off the front foot.
Fullish delivery around off, Roston Chase eases it towards mid off.

In the air but lands safely. This is dug in short and at the body, Alzarri Joseph looks to take it on but gets a top edge that goes up around square leg. The fielders from short leg and short mid-wicket try to get to it but it falls out of their reach. A single is taken.
Goes full and straight this time, Alzarri Joseph does well to jam it out.
Alzarri Joseph walks out to the middle.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Cameron Green comes back into the attack and picks up his first wicket of the game right away. Green serves this one full and outside off, Shamarh Brooks' eyes lit up as he looks to pounce on it and drive it through covers. The ball just nips away a touch and there's not much feet movement by Brooks. The outside edge is found and Alex Carey takes a simple catch behind the stumps. Australia will now look to clean up the West Indian tail.
Commentary.Howout: c Alex Carey b Cameron Green

Commentary.Commentary: Cummins with a good-length delivery on off. Chase with a solid block again. Good batting and good bowling as well.
Angles a length delivery on middle. Chase defends it to mid on.
Back of a length and drifts down the leg side. Chase lets it go as he watches it till the end.
Goes a bit straighter and fullish in length as Chase defends it yet again.
Serves a good-length delivery, around off. Chase leaves it alone this time. Good leave!.
Lands it on a length, on off. Chase with a solid block from his crease.
Back of a length and around off. It is angled across the right hander and Brooks gets beaten on the outside edge as he tries to defend it.
Goes for a yorker but ends up bowling a low full toss on off. Chase drives it off the bottom of his blade to right of mid off for a single.
FOUR LEG BYES! Handy runs for the Windies! Back of a length and around leg. Chase tries to clip it but misses. The ball goes off his thigh pad and away from the diving leg slip for a boundary.
On a length and around off. Chase dabs it towards point where Lyon does well to stop it with a dive.
Lovely delivery! A scrambled seam delivery that pitches around off and is angled across the right-hander. Chase tries to defend it but the ball beats the outside edge of his blade.
A fullish delivery on middle. Brooks flicks it right of mid on for a single.
Ends the over with a delivery that is just short of good length and around off. Chase makes a careful leave.
Goes fuller and on middle. Chase drives and drives it well but finds the mid on fielder.
Back of a length and outside off. Chase waits for it and leaves it alone.
Bowls a full delivery on middle. Brooks flicks it through mid-wicket and the batters run three. Nice shot!
Lovely delivery! Serves a good-length delivery, outside off. The ball seams away after pitching and Brooks also does well to keep his bat inside the line of the ball.
Back of a length, on off. Brooks keeps it out carefully.
Skipper, Pat Cummins (17-5-31-1) brings himself back into the attack.
On a length, on off. Chase defends it right under his eyes. Chase played this over quite well but he needs to keep his concentration levels up right throughout this session.
Tries to go full and angle it across the right hander but ends up bowling way too wide outside off. Easy leave for Chase.
No run.
Much fuller on off. Chase defends it calmly back to the bowler.
A fullish delivery on off. Chase fends it off the outside half of his blade to point.
On a length and angled across the right hander, Chase leaves it alone.

FOUR BYES! Josh Hazlewood goes fuller again but drifts down the leg side. Brooks tries to clip it but misses. Carey behind the stumps fails to collect it as the ball bounces just in front of him and goes past his gloves. It races away towards the fence.
Serves a fullish delivery and outside off. Good shape away from the batter as Brooks leaves it alone.
A bouncer that is angled around leg. Brooks watches it till the end and then lets it go.
A fullish delivery on off and Brooks defends it back to the bowler. Looking very solid here, Brooks!
Lands it on a length, on off. Brooks with a solid block from his crease.
FOUR! Poor delivery and Brooks gets a boundary! A rare bad delivery from Josh Hazlewood as he drifts on the pads. Brooks just tucks it towards the fine leg fence for a boundary.
Pulls his length back slightly and around off. Chase dabs it towards the point region.
A fuller delivery on middle. Shapes into him but Chase flicks it nicely past square leg for a couple.
Tries a variation ball as he bangs it short and around off. Chase ducks under it.
Again that delivery that shapes into the batter. Fuller in length and on off. Chase blocks it out.
Bowls it fuller and around off. Chase with a positive start as he leans forward and drives it through covers for a couple.
Roston Chase is the new man in.

OUT! KNOCKED HIM OVER! Right through the gate. It's a Mitchell Starc special! Fast and fuller swinging into middle at 145 kph. Joshua Da Silva tries to flick it but ends up playing all around that delivery as the ball sneaks between his bat and pad. Quite a poor shot this from Joshua Da Silva, he is a better batter than this but he is gone now. Aussies are right on top now.
Shortish delivery on off. Nasty delivery and Brooks hops and keeps it out onto the turf.
Oh, that's a brave leave! On a good length and again close to the off pole. This time it very close but Brooks leaves it on height.
Touch on the shorter side and on off again. Brooks with a solid block off the back foot.
A fullish delivery and outside off. The ball shapes away a bit as Brooks lets it go.
Lands it on a good length again, on off. Brooks covers the line of the ball and keeps it out nicely.
Josh Hazlewood lands it on a length and outside off. Brooks leaves it alone.
Goes fuller and on off. Joshua Da Silva drives it to mid off this time.
Bowls it full and down the leg side. Joshua Da Silva tries to flick it but misses.
Joshua Da Silva is the new man in.

OUT! LBW! Starc strikes with the new ball and Jermaine Blackwood gritty knock comes to an end. This is why Starc is so dangerous, if he gets it right, there are few bowlers in the world that can match him. He bowls a fullish delivery that shapes in nicely into Blackwood again. He tries to flick it but is late on his shot and gets hit on the pads. Starc makes a loud appeal and the umpire gives it out straightaway. Blackwood though takes the DRS. The replays roll in and according to Hotspot and Snicko there is no bat there. The Ball Tracking rolls and it shows umpire's call on wicket's hitting. So, the original decision stays and Jermaine Blackwood has to walk off.
Finds the right line and length finally! On a good length, on off and shaping into the batter. Brooks tries to defend it but gets the inside edge towards fine leg for a single.
Down the leg side again and touch on the shorter side. Brooks tries to clip it but misses.
Wayward delivery from Starc! Bowls a shortish delivery down the leg side and Brooks lets it go.
A good-length delivery, outside off. It shapes away nicely as Jermaine Blackwood leaves it.
Shortish delivery on off. Jermaine Blackwood rides the bounce nicely and blocks it out.
Goes back to the fuller length to find some swing, on off. Jermaine Blackwood connects his drive this time but hits it along the ground straight to mid off.
Lands it in that channel around off. Jermaine Blackwood presses forward a bit to defend it. The ball though straightens after pitching and beats the outside edge of his blade.
Now gets a good swing! Bowls a fullish length and outside off. Jermaine Blackwood goes for a big booming drive but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Just short of good length, around off.The ball bounces sharply and Jermaine Blackwood somehow manages to keep it out onto the turf.
Josh Hazlewood (18-3-49-1) to partner Mitchell Starc with the second new ball.
Touch shorter and angled across the right hander again. Brooks watches it carefully and leaves it. Not much swing for Starc there.
Lands it on a length, on off. Brooks defends it off the middle of his blade.
Just short of good length and angled across the right-hander. Brooks is aware of the angle and lets it go.
Pulls his length back slightly, on off. Brooks though is solid in his defence.
Starc bowls another full delivery on off at 140.2 kph. Brooks drives it back to the bowler.
Starts off with a fuller delivery that shapes into middle. Brooks works it towards mid-wicket.
The second new ball is now available. Will Pat Cummins take it straight away? Yes, he does take it instantly and it will be Mitchell Starc who will have the first go at it.
Nicely tossed up, on off. Jermaine Blackwood blocks it off the front foot.
Shorter in length and on middle. Brooks works it to square leg for a single.
Drifting on the pads and quicker again. Jermaine Blackwood works it behind square on the leg side for a single.
On middle and turning in. Jermaine Blackwood goes deep in his crease and works it off the bounce to short leg. Marnus Labuschagne fails to collect it and gets hit just near the box.
Quicker and around off. Touch shorter as well Jermaine Blackwood keeps it out.
Fuller and on middle. Jermaine Blackwood works it to mid-wicket.
Tossed up, on off. Brooks fends it off the front foot.

FOUR! Oh, just away from Head! Fuller delivery on off. Brooks drives it uppishly left of the bowler and Head dives to his left. However, he fails to get any hand on it as the ball races down the ground for a boundary.
Flatter and quicker again on off. Brooks blocks it out nicely again.
Bowls it fuller and around leg. Brooks tries to sweep it but misses.
Pushes it quicker on off. Brooks keeps it out off the back foot.
Bowls from 'round the wicket and on off. Brooks defends it off the back foot.
Travis Head, the part-time off-spinner to bowl from the opposite end.
Slower through the air, on off. Jermaine Blackwood takes a good stride forward and blocks it.
Oh, much quicker this one at 99 kph. It is tad short in length and around off. Jermaine Blackwood gets the inside edge onto his pads as he tries to defend it.
On the shorter side, on off. Jermaine Blackwood blocks it out.
This is a fuller delivery, outside off. Jermaine Blackwood drives it to covers now.
Another loopy delivery on middle. Brooks drives it down the ground for a single.
Starts off with a tossed up delivery on off. Brooks drives it straight to mid off.

We are back for the final session! With the second new ball due in just 3 overs, the Australians will look to attack. Shamarh Brooks and Jermaine Blackwood are all-set to continue their stay on the crease. Nathan Lyon with continue with his off-breaks after the interval.
... DAY 3, SESSION 3 ...

West Indies, well, they have fought hard in this Test so far. However, they are still 361 runs behind and have lost four wickets now. Almost all Windies batters have taken blows on their body and unfortunately Bonner has now been replaced by Brooks as a concussion substitute after he was hit on the helmet in the opening session. Blackwood though is still out there and is fighting it out as some big wickets have fallen around him. They need a big partnership here and let’s see how West Indies batters go about their business in the final session. Stay tuned.

A very productive session for the Aussies. They have picked three wickets in this session and right throughout have kept Windies batters on their toes. The session started with Cummins getting rid of West Indies skipper, Kraigg Brathwaite with a dream of a delivery. That opened the doors for this quality Australian bowling attack to put more pressure on the Windies and soon Starc got rid of shaky looking Mayers while Lyon got a big wicket of Holder after a fiery Hazlewood spell. Australians were brutal with the short-pitch stuff and this pitch seems to have quicken up now. Expect Aussies bowlers to come out all guns blazing in the final session as second new ball is just around the corner.
Tossed up, full and around off, Brooks drives it down to long off for a single. That will be Tea on Day 3!
Around the off stump, Brooks plays it late and well behind point for yet another brace.
Shorter and on middle, Shamarh Brooks turns it through mid-wicket and is quick to get back for the second.
Around off, this is eased away towards cover for a single.

Floated up on the pads, Shamarh Brooks gets a fine tickle on it and the ball races away towards the fine leg fence. David Warner from leg slip chases it down and manages to pull it back in. Three runs are taken.
A tad shorter and outside off, turning away, Brooks cuts it off the back foot but straight to point.
Shorter and around middle, worked away off the back foot towards mid-wicket for a quick single.
On a length around off and this one just skids on a bit quicker. Brooks rocks back and blocks it onto the on side.
Floated up around off, Brooks opens the face of the bat and eases it toward cover-point.
Flights it up a touch and bowls it around middle, Brooks defends it in front of the man at short leg.
Tossed up, full and around off, pushed away onto the off side.
Lyon switches ends and starts off with a quicker one. This is angled in from around off but goes straight on after pitching. Shamarh Brooks does well to keep it out.
Tossed up at the stumps, Blackwood defends it out with soft hands.
On a length and around middle, Blackwood watchfully defends it out.
This is a friendly full toss around middle but the ball just dips on the batter. Jermaine Blackwood ends up pushing it back to the bowler.
On the shorter side and over middle, Blackwood plays it off the back foot and onto the leg side.
This is floated up around off, Blackwood blocks it out on the off side.
Much better on the second attempt. Tosses it up around off, Blackwood defends it out.
NO BALL AND FOUR! Marnus Labuschagne oversteps and starts off with a real loosener as well. This is short and down the leg side, Jermaine Blackwood tucks it 'round the corner for a boundary.
Marnus Labuschagne is into the attack now. Interesting decision.
Just short! Short again and around the body, Brooks hops and does well to play at it with soft hands and keeps it down in front of short leg.
A bit of hostility here from Cameron Green. This is short and angled at the body. Brooks tries to fend it off the back foot but gets hurried on and takes a blow on the gloves.

FOUR! Just erring in line here Cameron Green and that's just easy pickings for Shamarh Brooks. Back of a length and angling down leg, Brooks whips it away well wide of the man at fine leg for a boundary, the second one of the over.
On a length and angling into middle and leg, Brooks keeps it out on the leg side.
Good length, around the top of off and this is pushed away towards covers.
NO BALL! A bouncer now from Green around the off stump and Brooks ducks under it. Green oversteps once again and a no ball is called.
FOUR! A teaser but it does go into the fence. A length ball on the pads, Shamarh Brooks clips it away through the square leg region and picks up a boundary.
Around off stump, Shamarh Brooks drags the sweep shot through square leg and the concussion substitute is off the mark with a single.
Shorter and around middle and leg, Brooks rocks back and dabs it down on the leg side.
Switches to over the wicket to the new man and tosses it up on off stump. Brooks gets forward well to defend.
Nicely flighted on the pads, Blackwood tickles it towards short fine leg for a quick single.
Just drags back the length a touch and keeps it around the pads, Jermaine Blackwood plays at it with soft hands and keeps it down on the leg side.
Loops it up around leg stump, Blackwood blocks it out on the leg side.
A jaffa to end the over! Lands it on a hard length and keeps it tight around off stump. The ball straightens off the deck and zips past the outside edge of Shamarh Brooks' bat.

This is excellent bowling from Cameron Green. Another short ball at the body and this is bowled right around the shoulder. Blackwood awkwardly fens it away and the ball goes through short fine leg. They get one.
Oh, almost pops up! Short ball at the body, Blackwood hops as he tries to block but gets it off the glove. Luckily for him, the ball doesn't lob up towards short leg.
Back of a length and around leg stump, this is flicked away towards mid-wicket.
'Catch,' is the call but it lands well short. This is full and angling into middle and leg, Jermaine Blackwood looks to drive but ends up pushing it uppishly towards mid on.
This is banged in short and around off, Blackwood ducks under it well.
NO BALL! This is full and at the stumps, Jermaine Blackwood drives it towards mid on. Green has overstepped and a no ball is called.
Shamarh Brooks walks out to the middle now. He has replaced Nkrumah Bonner as a concussion substitute. Let's hope that Bonner's injury is not that serious and it is just a precautionary measure.

OUT! TAKEN! The change of line has worked immediately for Nathan Lyon. Lyon switches to around the wicket and just floats it up on the pads with the ball turning in. Jason Holder looks to lean forward and clip it through the leg side but ends up closing the face of the bat early and flicking it behind. David Warner at leg slip is quick to react and gets down low to his left to take a sharp catch. Holder was looking dangerous but Lyon gets the better of him on this occasion.
Commentary.Howout: c David Warner b Nathan Lyon

Commentary.Commentary: On a nagging length and pushed through quicker on off stump, Holder goes on the back foot and makes the block.
Around middle stump, Holder keeps it out.
SIX! Right in the slot and dispatched! Tossed up on off stump and turning in. Jason Holder frees his arms and slogs it all the way over the wide long on fence for a biggie.
Switches to over the wicket now and tosses it up full and outside off, Holder leans on and eases it towards cover-point.
Drops it a bit short and on leg stump, Jermaine Blackwood goes on the back foot and whips it away towards deep mid-wicket for a single.

FOUR LEG BYES! Australians are firing short-pitch bullets and the Windies batters keep taking blows on the way. Green bowls a short delivery now angling into the body. Holder tries to duck under it but does not keep his eyes on the ball. The ball brushes his helmet and runs away towards the fine leg fence. Time for the mandatory Concussion Test now. The physio is out and Holder looks all fine to continue.
Green goes a bit fuller again and around off. Holder drives it crisply again but finds the mid off fielder.
Lands it on a length, on off. Holder with a solid block from his crease.
FOUR! Classy shot! Green overpitches on off. Holder leans forward and shows the full face of his blade as he drives it down the ground for a boundary.
Short delivery at 132 kph, angling into off. Holder sways away from the line of the ball.
Starts off with a fullish delivery on middle. Holder works it straight to mid on.
Cameron Green (4-0-9-0) is back on.
Loopy delivery on off. Jermaine Blackwood though gets well forward and blocks it out.
Tossed up delivery on off. Jermaine Blackwood works it to mid-wicket this time.
Tossed up on off. Holder reverse-paddles it and hits in the gap as the ball is stopped just inside the ropes near the third man fence. Three taken.
Natural variation of an off-spinner beats him this time. Tossed up, around off. Holder presses forward to defend but the ball beats the outside edge as it does not turn and goes back to the keeper.
Bowls it on middle and flatter. Jermaine Blackwood works it behind square on the leg side for a single.
Pitches it on and turns this ball into middle at a good pace. Jermaine Blackwood lets it spin and blocks it out.
Hazlewood with a shortish delivery on off. Holder drops his wrists as the ball hits his biceps and goes back to the keeper.
Serves it on a length again, on off. Holder blocks it out solidly.

Lands it on a length angling into middle and leg. Holder tries to work it towards the leg side but misses and gets rapped up on the pads. A half an appeal by the bowler and the fielders but it is going down leg.
Keeps it on the shorter side but it is a harmless delivery as it is way outside off. Holder leaves it alone.
Touch shorter and on off. Holder stays deep in his crease and defends it towards the off side.
Bangs it short and on middle. Holder ducks under it.
Quicker delivery again and flatter. Jermaine Blackwood with a solid block.
On middle and fuller again. Jermaine Blackwood pushes it towards left of short mid-wicket where the fielder makes a good stop diving to his left.
Fuller delivery and slower through the air, on off. Jermaine Blackwood keeps it out off the front foot.
Tad shorter and turning into off. Jermaine Blackwood blocks it off the back foot.
Fullish delivery on middle. Holder knocks it down to long on for a single.
Tossed up, on off. Holder blocks it out.
Back of a length and outside off. Jermaine Blackwood lets it go. Good battle going on here between Josh Hazlewood and Jermaine Blackwood.
Jermaine Blackwood is definitely rattled a bit by this short-pitch stuff. Josh Hazlewood angles a shortish delivery on the body and Jermaine Blackwood just about manages to keep it out.
Back of a length, on middle. Jermaine Blackwood clips it to deep backward square leg for a couple.

Oh, that's a ripper from Josh Hazlewood! A perfect short delivery on off as Jermaine Blackwood is caught off-guard. He hops and looks to keep it out. However, the ball goes off the shoulder of his blade and loops up in the in front of gully. Green there runs forward and dives to take it but fails to reach it in the end.
Targets the middle stump again. On  length and Jermaine Blackwood defends it towards the leg side.
A length delivery and angling into middle. Jermaine Blackwood clips it to mid-wicket.
Flatter and quicker on off. Holder blocks it solidly.
Lovely tossed up delivery. It induces Holder to press for a forward defence. However, the ball goes straight off the deck and beats the outside edge of his blade.
Flighted delivery on off. Holder drives it to mid off.
FOUR! Lovely shot! Tossed up and outside off. It is a half-volley and Holder takes a big stride forward and caresses it through covers for a boundary.
Slower through the air and around off. Holder fends it with soft hands and opens the face of his blade a bit. The ball runs through the third man region and couple of runs are taken.
Tossed up, on off. Holder with a solid block.

Oh, that's a nasty delivery! Josh Hazlewood bowls this bouncer at a perfect awkward height angling into the body. Jermaine Blackwood tries to sway away from the line of the ball but the ball goes onto his his handle and gloves.
A slight halt in play as the string off the bottom of Jermaine Blackwood's bat seems to have come off. The 12th man is out with a new bat and Blackwood is good to continue.
On a length and outside off. Jermaine Blackwood goes deep in his crease and plays it quite late as he dabs it towards the off side.
Angles a fullish delivery on middle. Holder clips it to mid-wicket for a single.
Goes fuller and on off. Holder with a solid defence again.
Just short of good length, on off. Holder stays deep in his crease and blocks it out.
Touch shorter and outside off. Holder lets it go with ease.

Drinks break! Well, it has been a fascinating first hour of the post-lunch session to say the least. Pat Cummins and Mitchell Starc started spitting fire after the break and the Windies skipper Kraigg Brathwaite was soon dismissed after a handy knock. After his departure, the batting looked shaky and Mayers, after a couple of scares did get out. And, just a couple of overs back there was a controversial decision as Holder was judged out on the field but the third umpire deemed it not out on the basis of a spike on UltraEdge. The next hour should be as exciting, if not more.
Pushes it bit quicker on middle. Jermaine Blackwood defends it off the back foot and the ball loops up a bit in air and falls just away from the short leg fielder.
Slower through the air and on middle. Jermaine Blackwood works it towards the leg side.

FOUR! Streaky but a boundary for Jermaine Blackwood! A shortish delivery and just outside off. Jermaine Blackwood goes back and tries to punch it. However, he gets a thick outside edge that runs away through the gap towards the third man fence.
Another flighted delivery on off. Jermaine Blackwood pushes it to covers.
Slower through the air, on off. Jermaine Blackwood blocks it off the front foot.
Tossed up delivery on off. Jermaine Blackwood drives it to covers.

A change from both ends now as Nathan Lyon (9-1-31-0) is back into the attack. Lyon is in discussion with the umpire about the previous lbw decision and the Aussies, rightly so aren't convinced with it. Also, some protective equipment is coming onto the field as a fielder is now placed at short leg.

A fullish delivery on middle. Holder tries to drive it but seems to have missed it as the ball hits his back leg. Josh Hazlewood appeals and the umpire raises his finger. It did look out to the naked eye but Holder takes the DRS straightaway and looks pretty confident as well. The replays roll in and the Hotspot shows no bat invloved. However, there is a spike as the ball passes the blade on the Snicko. The on-field umpire himself seems to be confused and first gives it out and then realises that he has made a mistake and gives it not out. There is lot of confusion on the field and Australian players are not happy. However, the offical decision is not out and that is what matters. Holder will continue!
Better line! On a good length again but this time close to the off pole. However, Holder is aware enough of his off stump and leaves it alone.
Back of a length and outside off. Holder leaves it alone.
Touch shorter and angling into middle. Holder clips it to deep square leg for a couple.
Hits that good length area on off. Holder though leaves it on height as the ball goes over the off pole back to the keeper.
Josh Hazlewood starts off with a fullish delivery on off. Holder leans forward and drives it crisply to mid off.
Josh Hazlewood (14-2-44-1) is brought back into the attack.
Short and outside off. Jermaine Blackwood punches it through covers for a couple. Jermaine Blackwood is looking quite comfortable in the middle.
On a length and angling into middle. Jermaine Blackwood works it right of mid on and looks for a single but is sent back by his partner.
Shortish delivery and angling into the body at 135 kph. Holder rides the bounce and works it behind square to the leg side for a single.
Goes fuller and on middle. Jermaine Blackwood clips it to square leg for a single.
Serves it on a length, on off at 132 kph. Jermaine Blackwood fends it from his crease towards mid on.
Cummins with a back-of-a-length delivery on off. Jermaine Blackwood calmly blocks it out.
Fullish length, well outside off and it is once again left alone by Holder. Maiden!
Starc tries to attack the pads but just snatches at it a bit and pulls the trigger down the leg side. Alex Carey does well to collect that one.
Keeps it full but this time tries to angle it in from outside off. Holder makes an easy leave.
Switches to 'round the wicket now and tries to attack the base of middle stump, Holder jams it out towards extra cover.
On a length around off and seaming away, Jason Holder lets it through to the keeper.
Full and in that channel around off stump, Holder leaves it alone.
This is very full and angling into the leg stump, Holder manages to get some bat on it and flicks it through backward square leg for a run.
Well left! A touch fuller now, close to the off pole and jagging back in a touch. Jason Holder trusts the bounce and shoulders arms at it.
A good bumper now over off stump, Holder is able to duck under it though.
This is pitched up on middle stump, Holder blocks it out towards mid on.
On a good length again and angling into the pads, Holder looks to flick but misses and gets hit high on the pads.
Good length around middle and leg, Jermaine Blackwood tucks it away through square leg for a single.
Pitched up on off stump, Jason Holder pushes at it with soft hands and edges it down through backward point. The batters hurry back for the second and that is excellent running.
Starc is just probing away around the off stump. This is full again, trying to induce the drive but Holder resists the temptation and leaves it alone.
This is very full and at 144 clicks around off stump, Holder watchfully leaves it alone.
Fullish length and slanted across Holder who makes yet another leave.
This is on a good length outside off, trying to bring it back into the right-hander. Jason Holder leaves it alone.
Jason Holder is the next batter in.

OUT! KNOCKED HIM OVER! Kyle Mayers' stay at the crease is a short one. Mitchell Starc steams in from over the wicket and angles in a full ball into the off pole. This is bowled at over 144 clicks and catches Mayers out. Once again Mayers' feet don't go anywhere and he is late in his attempted drive as well. The ball takes a faint inside edge and goes on to castle into the stumps. These are dangerous times for the Windies batters as they look to fend off the Aussie quicks.
Pitches it up now and angles it into the off pole, Blackwood looks to drive but gets an inside edge onto the leg side.
Fullish length at the stumps, nudged away in front of mid-wicket.
Pat Cummins seems to have found his rhythm here. A short ball now over middle stump and this one just climbs on the batter. Jermaine Blackwood does well to hop and keep it down on the deck.
Goes full now and angles one into the middle stump. Mayers looks to drive at it but gets an inside edge towards fine leg and gets off the mark with a single.
Nagging length, on the fifth stump line and just staying a bit low. Kyle Mayers doesn't move his feet as he looks to play the cover drive. The ball goes past the outside edge.
On a hard length and around off, Mayers stays on the back foot and pushes it out on the off side.
Full and trying to attack the pads but it is spilled down the leg side by Starc.
Good length, angling across the right-hander, Blackwood lets it through to the keeper.
Starc shortens the length and bowls it over leg stump, Blackwood hops and nudges it down on the leg side.

Poor running, that should have been an easy three. Starc keeps it full and wide, Blackwood plays a lovely cover drive and it is a long chase for the fielder who runs behind it from covers. They, however, take only two and are content with it.

Edged and FOUR! This is full and wide again at 143.3 clicks. Jermaine Blackwood goes for the flashy cover drive but the ball takes the outside edge and goes in between the slip cordon and gully for a boundary. An extra slip there and Blackwood was a goner.
Mitchell Starc comes from over the wicket and angles across a full and wide one, Jermaine Blackwood strokes it away towards extra cover.
A length ball on off stump, Mayers flicks it away towards mid-wicket. Top over from Pat Cummins, a wicket-maiden.
Around the top of off, Mayers just about keeps it out on the off side.

Was there any bat on it? No, just past the outside edge. Fuller in length and angling in from around off. The ball seams away a touch and zips past the outside edge as Kyle Mayers looks to block it off the front foot. There is an appeal from behind but Cummins isn't interested and rightly so.

Absolute ripper! Pat Cummins switches to around the wicket and welcomes Kyle Mayers to the crease with a sharp bouncer. This is around off and angling in at a good height. Mayers looks to sway away from the line of the ball but the ball hits the left shoulder and Alex Carey leaps up brilliantly to grab it.
Kyle Mayers, the talented left-handed batter walks out to the middle now.

OUT! TIMBER! Skipper to skipper and at last, Pat Cummins does have his 200th Test wicket and he has certainly deserved it. This is a dream delivery from Cummins as he serves it on a length and angles it into middle and off. Kraigg Brathwaite looks to block and plays down the correct line but the ball just straightens a touch off the deck and beats the outside edge going on to hit the top of off stump. Brathwaite departs after a solid knock but Australia now have a chance to go hard at the Windies middle order.
Full and straight from Cummins, Brathwaite blocks it back to the bowler.
Tentative drive! Full and pushed well outside off, Brathwaite goes after it but ends up just pushing at it. The ball goes to the left of the man at cover and they get a run as well.
TWO LEG BYES! Shorter and around the hips, Brathwaite plays it off the thigh pad again and down to fine leg. The batters pick up a couple of leg byes.
Back of a length and around off, Blackwood goes on the back foot and dabs it down with gentle hands towards backward point for one. The 50-run stand between these two is up.
Starc switches to over the wicket and angles across a full ball at 141 clicks. Jermaine Blackwood gets pushed onto the back foot and has a feel for it but the ball beats the outside edge.
Fullish length around off, Brathwaite plays it square of the wicket towards cover-point for an easy single.
FOUR LEG BYES! A bit too straight from Starc. Good length around the pads, Brathwaite looks to tickle it fine but misses. The ball goes off the thigh pads and runs away into the fine leg fence.
Back-to-back maidens! This is a touch fuller and around off, Jermaine Blackwood presses forward and solidly keeps it out on the off side.
On a good length and around off stump, Blackwood watchfully leaves it alone.
Very full and on off stump, just shaping away a touch as well. Jermaine Blackwood punches it back out on the deck.
This is pitched up around off, Blackwood pushes it back to the bowler.
Goes fuller now and around the fifth stump line, Blackwood lets it through to the keeper.
Cummins digs it in a bit short and around the body. Jermaine Blackwood hops and keeps it down on the leg side.
Pat Cummins to start the proceedings from the other end. The Australian skipper has bowled quite well so far but without any success.

Just staying a touch low. Nagging length around off and angling in. Brathwaite looks to defend it with a straight bat but the ball seams away and beats the outside edge. Starc starts off the session with a maiden.
This one's pitched up on off stump, Brathwaite drives it tentatively and towards mid on.
Full again, at 142 clicks and attacking middle and leg stump. Brathwaite keeps it out on the leg side.
This is full and at the stumps, Brathwaite punches it back towards the bowler.
Just brings the length back a touch and brings it a bit closer to the off pole as well. Brathwaite looks to block but the ball holds its line and passes the outside edge.
Starc begins the session from around the stumps and angles in a very full ball from outside off. Kraigg Brathwaite jams it out on the off side.

Welcome back, folks! We are ready for the post-Lunch session and it promises to be a riveting one! Australian players have taken the field and the two Windies batters, Jermaine Blackwood and Kraigg Brathwaite are also in the middle now to resume their innings. Mitchell Starc to start with the ball. Here we go...
… DAY 3, SESSION 2 …

Josh Hazlewood started the new day with a wicket and with the way he and Pat Cummins were bowling early on, Australia would have expected to take more than just one wicket but the opposition has been stubborn. Apart from those two, other bowlers couldn't quite challenge the Windies batters much and Nathan Lyon was put under pressure as Brathwaite stayed aggressive against him. The pitch is still pretty good for batting and the bounce is true but a couple of slip-ups here and there and West Indies could be under immense pressure. Will the visitors continue to frustrate the hosts? Or will Australia be able to expose the middle order and get back on top of the proceedings? Find out soon as the post-lunch session begins at 10.30 am IST (5 am GMT).

Most of the action happened in the opening over of the day as debutant Tagenarine Chanderpaul brought up a fifty and then was dismissed the very next ball. Skipper Kraigg Brathwaite and Nkrumah Bonner then steadied the ship and looked to stitch together a decent stand but Bonner took a blow on the backside of his helmet and eventually after a couple of overs had to leave the field as a precautionary measure. Since then, Brathwaite has brought up yet another half-century and has been aggressive against Lyon with Jermaine Blackwood hanging on at the other end.

Session summary - 26 overs, 76 runs and 1 wicket. Yet another engrossing session of Test cricket has gone by and probably, West Indies will be happier of the two teams heading into the lunch break. The Aussie quicks have been on the money but don't have much to show for their efforts and would be hoping to change that in the next session.
Serves a length delivery on off. Jermaine Blackwood blocks it out solidly as he covers the line of the ball nicely here. That's Lunch on Day 3!
A length delivery on off. Bit of shape into the batter and Kraigg Brathwaite defends it with the inside half of his blade towards the leg side. Single taken. 150 up for West Indies!
Shortens his length now on off. Kraigg Brathwaite rides the bounce and blocks it out.
Goes a bit fuller and on off. Kraigg Brathwaite is as solid as ever.
Angles a length delivery on middle. Kraigg Brathwaite covers the line of the ball and fends it onto the turf.
On a length, on off. Kraigg Brathwaite defends it towards the off side.
Tossed up, on off. Jermaine Blackwood blocks it off the front foot.
On the shorter side again, on off. Jermaine Blackwood goes back and tries to work it towards the leg side but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Touch shorter and on off. Jermaine Blackwood blocks it off the back foot.

FOUR! Jermaine Blackwood is getting more and more confident with each delivery! This is tossed up and wider outside off. Jermaine Blackwood strides forward and drives it through covers for a boundary.
Lovely flighted delivery again, on off. Jermaine Blackwood blocks it off the front foot.
Tossed up and around off. Kraigg Brathwaite opens the face of his blade as he presses forward to defend and takes a single towards the backward point region.
Hits the hard length, on off. Jermaine Blackwood defends it right under his eyes.
On the shorter side again, around off. Jermaine Blackwood punches it through covers for a couple.
Back of a length and angling into the body. Kraigg Brathwaite tries to clip it but misses. The ball goes off his thigh pad towards the leg side and a leg bye is taken.
On the shorter side and around off. Kraigg Brathwaite dabs it towards point. Again plays it late and with soft hands. Good batting this!
A fullish delivery on off. Kraigg Brathwaite drives it back to the bowler.
On a good length, on off. Kraigg Brathwaite defends it solidly from his crease.
Josh Hazlewood (12-2-41-1) is brought back into the attack.
Tossed up, on off. Kraigg Brathwaite sweeps it to deep square leg for a single this time.
Touch short and around off. Kraigg Brathwaite defends it from his crease.
Around off and turning into the batter. Kraigg Brathwaite plays it late and fends it towards the off side.
Pushes it quicker on off. Kraigg Brathwaite blocks it out.
FOUR! Another good shot from Kraigg Brathwaite! Great placement! This is fuller and on off. Kraigg Brathwaite sweeps and sweeps it wll through square leg for a boundary.
Flatter and quicker on off. Kraigg Brathwaite defends it off the back foot.
In the gap! On the shorter side and around off. Jermaine Blackwood rides the bounce nicely and opens the face of his blade just a bit. The ball runs through the point region for a couple.
Angles a shortish delivery on off from 'round the wicket and Jermaine Blackwood does well to block it again.
On the shorter side, on off. Jermaine Blackwood hops and defends it out.
Bowls it fuller and on off. Kraigg Brathwaite drives it wide of mid off for a single.
Back of a length and around off. Kraigg Brathwaite rides the bounce and blocks it out.

FOUR! Oh, wide of second slip! On a length and angled across the batter. Kraigg Brathwaite pushes it away from hos body. The ball though goes off the outside edge of his blade and wide of Smith who dives to his right but fails to reach it. The ball races away towards the third man fence.

FIFTY For Kraigg Brathwaite! This has been a superb knock from the skipper, great grit and determination all through. This one is fuller and on middle. Kraigg Brathwaite flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up and fuller on off. Kraigg Brathwaite drives it to mid off.
Pushes it quicker again and tad shorter on off. Kraigg Brathwaite blocks it out.
This time quicker and flatter, around leg. Kraigg Brathwaite tries to sweep but misses.
SIX! Good positive intent from Kraigg Brathwaite! Tossed up, on mddle. Kraigg Brathwaite dances down the track and tonks it down the ground for a maximum.
Pitches it on middle and turns into Kraigg Brathwaite. He goes back and defends it towards the leg side.
Good length around off, Blackwood watches it all the way through and leaves it alone.
Short ball now, at 141.3 clicks and looking to attack the body but it is down the leg side. Blackwood does well to read the line of the ball and move out of the way of the delivery.
A length ball around middle and leg, this is easily blocked out by Jermaine Blackwood.
Nicely done. Starc goes a bit fuller and bowls it around off stump at over 141 clicks. Jermaine Blackwood looks to block but the ball just straightens a touch and whizzes past the outside edge.
On a hard length and over leg stump, Blackwood hops and dabs it down on the leg side.
A bouncer now, over leg stump and a bit too high for Jermaine Blackwood to play at it.
Around middle and leg, Brathwaite keeps it down in front of short leg.
This is down the leg side, Brathwaite leaves it alone but the ball hits the pads and goes towards leg slip.
Shorter in length and turning into the pads, Brathwaite looks to work it past the fielder at short leg but fails to beat him.
Flighted, around middle and leg, this is nudged away onto the leg side.
FOUR! Well played! This is tossed up around off stump, Kraigg Brathwaite gets inside the line of the ball and sweeps it away behind square on the leg side for a boundary.
On a length and turning in sharply from off stump, Brathwaite just shoulders arms and the ball hits him on the body.
Lovely delivery! Fuller length, close to the off pole and at around 144 clicks. The ball just zips off the deck as Blackwood looks to drive but gets beaten past the outside edge.
Short of a length and around off, Jermaine Blackwood hops and defends it down on the deck.
On a hard length and on off stump, Blackwood gets right behind the line to make another solid block.
Good length around middle stump, Blackwood keeps it out without any fuss.
Starc hits the length hard and bowls it on off stump, Blackwood defends it off the back foot.
Fullish length, close to the off pole and angling across. Kraigg Brathwaite plays at it with soft hands and gets an outside edge down to third man for a single.
Fuller this time around and on leg stump, Blackwood pushes it towards mid on.
On a length and around leg stump, Jermaine Blackwood looks to play it off the back foot but ends up blocking it onto the deck.
Lyon pulls the length back a shade and bowls it around the pads, Brathwaite goes on the back foot and nudges it past the diving fielder at leg slip for a run.

A bit of aggression from the Windies skipper. Lyon switches to 'round the wicket and floats it up on leg stump. Brathwaite advances and drags the slog in front of deep mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Tosses it up on a length and outside off, there is a good bit of turn into the right-hander. Jermaine Blackwood just works it away through mid-wicket for a single.
Starts off with a shortish delivery on off stump. This one turns in and Blackwood keeps it down towards short leg.
Time for spin now as Nathan Lyon gets his opportunity to have a crack at Jermaine Blackwood and Kraigg Brathwaite. He bowled 4 overs on Day 2 and got some good turn.
Shorter this time and angled across the off stump, Kraigg Brathwaite stays on the back foot and just eases it through extra cover for a couple of more runs.
Full again around off, Brathwaite drives again but is unable to beat the man at mid off to his left.
Overpitched from Starc and outside off, Kraigg Brathwaite drives it uppishly through the cover region and picks up a couple of runs.
A length ball on off stump, Brathwaite defends it off the front foot.
On a hard length and around off, Brathwaite gets right behind the line of the ball to keep it down on the deck.
Around the top of off and angling across the right-hander, Brathwaite looks to defend but is beaten past the outside edge.
Excellent running! Back of a length and around off, Brathwaite hops and keeps it down in front of covers and scampers through for one.
This is around middle and leg, Brathwaite pushes it towards mid on.
A length ball at the stumps, Brathwaite keeps it out.
A touch fuller and at the stumps, Brathwaite defends it out on the leg side.
Leg bye! Good length around the pads, Blackwood looks to flick but gets it off his pads past square leg. They get a leg bye.
On a fullish length and attacking middle and leg, Blackwood punches it towards mid on.
NO BALL! This is full and straight, Jermaine Blackwood negotiates his first ball well as he blocks it towards mid on. A no ball is called for overstepping.

Drinks break. It has been an absorbing hour of play! Australian bowlers were right on the mark from ball one and Josh Hazlewood got rid of the debutant Tagenarine Chanderpaul early. After that, both Cummins and Josh Hazlewood kept beating the outside edge of both the batter's blade but Bonner and Kraigg Brathwaite have managed to survive and we must say Windies are showing some good fight here. They need to keep their focus on in the next hour of play as well because Aussie bowlers will keep coming hard at them. Oh, wait! Nkrumah Bonner is walking off the field. He is feeling dizzy because of the blow he took on his helmet some overs back. Hopefully, he will be back soon and Jermaine Blackwood now walks out to the middle to replace him.
Ouch! Nkrumah Bonner is looking in some discomfort and is unable to continue. A blow to the batting team as Nkrumah Bonner is retired hurt.
A half-volley around off and at around 141 clicks. Nkrumah Bonner just bunts it onto the off side and scampers across for a single.
Full and around off, Bonner shoulders arms.
Fullish length around off, Bonner watchfully leaves it alone.
A bit of a fumble and the batters take two with ease. Very full and wide, Nkrumah Bonner caresses it through extra cover for a couple of runs.

Risky single but good running. Nagging length, shaping it in from around middle. Brathwaite looks to defend but gets an inside edge towards mid-wicket. They go for the single and the direct hit is missed at the batter's end but it seems Bonner would have been home anyways.
Starc starts from over the wicket and serves a full ball outside off. Brathwaite frees his arms a bit and drives it past mid off for a couple of runs.
Mitchell Starc (7-2-15-0) to bowl his first over of the day now.
Pitches it up now and looks to attack the stumps, Bonner is able to get a bat on it.
This is dug in short and over the stumps, Bonner ducks under it.

FOUR! Width on offer. Fuller in length but well outside off, Nkrumah Bonner goes for the drive but gets it off the outer half of the bat and well past the slip cordon into the fence. The 100 is now up for West Indies.
On a length and this is angled into middle and leg. The ball skids through but Bonner is able to keep it out.
A touch fuller around the fourth stump and zipping off the deck, Nkrumah Bonner shoulders arms at it.
Green goes full and straight, Brathwaite pushes it back past the bowler and to the left of the man at mid on to pick up an easy single.
Good length around leg stump, Bonner nudges it onto the leg side. Maiden!
BEATEN! Pitches it up now in that channel around off and angles it in. The ball shapes away beautifully after pitching and completely squares up Bonner who is beaten past the outside edge.
Cummins bowls this one on a hard length, around middle and leg, Bonner hops and looks to tuck it away but misses and gets hit on the thigh pad.
Goes fuller now and keeps it outside off, Bonner punches it on the up but straight toward short cover.
Good length, angling it in from around off, Nkrumah Bonner presses forward to make the block.
Serves it on a length and around off stump, Bonner defends it off the front foot.
Back of a length and over middle, this one gets up pretty high but it is solidly kept down by Brathwaite.
Length ball, around middle and leg, Brathwaite has a slight shuffle across off stump and blocks it out.
Pitches it up now on off stump, Brathwaite pushes it out towards silly mid off.
A good bumper now, over the stumps and jumping off the surface. Kraigg Brathwaite gets taken aback a bit but manages to get out of the way.
Full and angling onto the pads, Bonner flicks it down to fine leg for a single.
This is bowled fuller and in that channel around off, Nkrumah Bonner shoulders arms.

Beaten! A frustrated look on the face of Cummins. He has bowled well but has not been able to find that edge. Just short of good length and outside off. Kraigg Brathwaite tries to punch it away from his body but misses it.
On the shorter side, on off. Kraigg Brathwaite though plays it quite well as he rides the bounce and dabs it towards the off side.
On a length, on off. Kraigg Brathwaite fends it out from his crease.
Bowls a half-volley, around off. Kraigg Brathwaite drives but finds the mid off fielder.

A fullish delivery, on off. Kraigg Brathwaite sees an opportuntiy to score runs and tries to drive it. However, the ball coms into Kraigg Brathwaite a bit and finds the inside edge of his blade. It goes onto hit his pads.
On a length, on off. Kraigg Brathwaite keeps it out with ease.
Back of a length, on off. Bonner waits for it and plays it with soft hands towards the off side.
Bouncer again but this time Bonner does well to duck under it. On middle and at  a good pace but negotiated well by Bonner.
Serves a good-length delivery, outside off. Bonner leaves it alone.

Nkrumah Bonner has been hit on the backside of his helmet but seems to be fine. There will however be a mandatory concussion check as the physio comes out to have a look. There will be a change of helmet for Bonner and hence a bit of an extended delay. It has been changed now and we are good to continue.

Oh, that has hit him on the helmet! Sharp bouncer by Green angles it on middle. Bonner takes his eyes off the ball and tries to duck under it but the ball goes onto hit his helmet. He will need some treatment here!
Hits the good length and outside off. The ball shapes away and Bonner makes a good leave.
Starts off with a length delivery on middle. Kraigg Brathwaite clips it to square leg for a single.
Cameron Green to bowl for the first time in this match.
Beaten! Very close to the outside edge of Bonner's blade this time. Serves a good-length delivery, around the off pole. Bonner tries to defend it but the ball straightens and beats him.

FOUR! Lovely shot! This is good batting, you need to score runs when you get an opportunity. Overpitched delivery, around off. Bonner takes a good stride forward and creams it through covers for a boundary.
Cummins with a length delivery on off. Bonner blocks it solidly.
Now gets back to his good length! Serves it around off. Bonner tries to defend it off the front foot but the ball just seems to be missing the outside edges of these blades right now.
Bangs it short and it is angled around leg. Bonner ducks under it.
Cummins hits that hard length again, on off. Bonner tries to defend it but gets the inside edge onto his pads.
Just short of good length this time and outside off. Kraigg Brathwaite leaves it alone.
Banged in short and it is outside off. Kraigg Brathwaite ducks under it.
Good leave! Lands it on a good length and around off. The ball seams into him a bit but Kraigg Brathwaite covers his off stump and lets it go.
Serves a good-length delivery, around off. Kraigg Brathwaite defends it off the front foot.
Lands on a length, on off. Bonner blocks it towards the off side and takes a quick single.
On a good length, on off. Bonner defends it solidly from his crease.
A fullish delivery and it shapes away nicley from Kraigg Brathwaite as he gets beaten again. Good thing is that he is managing to keep himself inside the line of the ball.
And again! Continues to hit good length and serves it around off. The ball straightens again after pitching and beats Kraigg Brathwaite as he tries to defend it.

Touch fuller again and around off. Bonner drives it to covers for a single.
A fullish delivery on middle and shaping into the batter. Bonner flicks it to mid-wicket now.
Pulls his length back this time, on off. Bonner rides the bounce and blocks it out.
Lovely delivery! Serves a good-length delivery, outside off. Bonner presses forward to defend it but the ball seams away and beats the outside edge of his blade.

Shortish length and outside off. Kraigg Brathwaite plays it with the angled blade and soft hands. The ball goes through the backward point region for a couple.
Gets back to his good length stuff, around off. Kraigg Brathwaite tries to defend it but the ball straightens after coming in with the angles and beats the outside edge of Kraigg Brathwaite's blade.
Bowls a short one and angles it around leg. Kraigg Brathwaite ducks under it.
The ball seams away sharply here! It probably hits that crack outside off. This one is just short of good length. The ball goes away from Kraigg Brathwaite as he leaves it.
Lands it on a good length again and outside off. Kraigg Brathwaite leaves it alone.
Cummins hits that good length and keeps it around off. Kraigg Brathwaite plays it very late as he allows it to shape away and defends it towards the off side.
Continues to hit that good length, outside off. Bonner makes a watchful leave.
Bowls a fullish delivery and outside off. The ball swings away a bit and beats the outside edge of Bonner's blade as he tries to defend it.
Serves another good-length delivery on off. Bonner blocks it right under his eyes.
Angles a length delivery on middle. Bonner defends it towards mid on.
Serves it on a length, on off. Bonner blocks it solidly from his crease.
Serves a good-length delivery, outside off. Bonner watches it carefully and lets it go.
On a good length, on off. Kraigg Brathwaite blocks it off the front foot.
A fullish delivery on middle. Bonner tries to flick it but gets the inside edge on his pads. The ball rolls towards the leg side and Bonner takes a single to get off the mark.
On a length, on off. Bonner with a solid block off the front foot.
Oh, beaten again! A fullish delivery, around off. It is shaping away and Bonner tries to drive it away. The ball beats the outside edge of his blade again.
A good-length delivery, around off. The ball shapes away a bit and beats the outside edge of Bonner's blade as he tries to defend.
A fullish delivery on middle and leg. Kraigg Brathwaite flicks it to fine leg for a single.
Nkrumah Bonner walks in at number 3. And it will be Pat Cummins to operate from the opposite end.

OUT! CAUGHT! Gone this time and Josh Hazlewood strikes early on Day 3! End of a very good knock on debut by Tagenarine Chanderpaul.
